text: 1. The first page of the individual ordinary passport. The passport's validity period must be until March 1, 2026 or later. If it does not meet the time limit requirement, please replace it in advance. 2. High school diploma. Fresh graduates should submit a certificate of expected graduation issued by their current school. The original or notarized copy of the high school diploma must be submitted before enrollment. 3. Complete transcript of all courses during high school. Fresh graduates should submit the transcript up to the present stage and provide the complete transcript before enrollment. 4. Language proficiency test scores. Applicants for programs taught in Chinese must provide a HSK score report. Applicants whose compulsory courses in secondary education (junior high school and senior high school) were taught in Chinese must provide proof of Chinese language instruction in junior high school and senior high school and are exempt from submitting a HSK score report. Applicants for programs taught in English must provide a TOEFL or IELTS score report or other proof of their English proficiency (native English speakers are exempt). 5. Personal Statement. Approximately 800 words, the content should include personal learning experiences, reasons for application, and personal strengths, etc. 6. Two recommendation letters. Written by high school teachers, they must be signed by the recommenders and include their contact phone numbers and email addresses. 7. Certificates of awards in subject competitions during high school (if any).
